findings.issue: guard_context uses context.route('**/*') routing every request (navigation, redirect hops, subresources) through check_url, aborting on HostRefused, plus a cross-origin navigation block. This is correct and fails closed. Gaps: Playwright route does not intercept WebSocket connections or service-worker-originated fetches, so page JS on an allowlisted host could still reach a non-allowlisted host that way.
findings.fix_hint: Create the context with service_workers='block' and add context.route_web_socket('**/*', ...) (or page.route_web_socket) that closes sockets failing check_url.
